# Blocks

Body text with **bold**, *italic*, ~~struck~~, ==highlighted==, `inline code`, and a #tag.

> A plain blockquote sits quietly in muted text.

## Code

```js
const greet = (name) => `Hello, ${name}`; // a comment
```

```python
def area(r: float) -> float:
    return 3.14159 * r ** 2
```

```elixir
IO.puts("an unlisted language shows the generic label")
```

## Callouts

> [!note] Note
> Coral title on a soft card.

> [!tip] Tip
> Green for success-like states.

> [!warning] Warning
> Amber for caution.

> [!danger] Danger
> Red for errors.

> [!example] Table in a callout
> | Column | Value |
> | --- | --- |
> | one | 1 |
> | two | 2 |
